pages.text: Raw Quartz Clusters are a light source. They can be collected with a pick bearing the Silk Touch enchantment; otherwise breaking a Raw Quartz Cluster will return a piece of $(l:items/raw_quartz)Raw Radiant Quartz$().$(br2)$(item)Thaumcraft$() Raw Quartz Clusters can be used as an infusion stabilizer.
Raw Quartz Clusters are created over time on top of a $(l:blocks/radiant_resonator)Radiant Resonator$().
